entries.title: The Expendabros

emulation.notes: Use the native Steam release; no emulation is needed.

primary.why: The Windows PC version is the best archive route because The Expendabros is a free standalone Steam release, has the complete ten-mission crossover campaign, and is easiest to capture. The macOS version is the same content family.
primary.how_to_play: Install The Expendabros for free on Steam for Windows PC and play its standalone crossover campaign before or after Broforce.

entries.remaster_caveats: This is a standalone The Expendables 3 crossover using Broforce-style gameplay, not a DLC row inside Broforce.

entries.title: Broforce
entries.definitive_edition: Broforce on Windows PC with Broforce Forever

emulation.notes: Use the native PC release with the current update; no emulation is needed.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native PC pixel-art presentation with current update content.

primary.version: Current PC release with Broforce Forever update
primary.why: The Windows PC version is the best archive route because it has the current Broforce Forever update, PC capture/settings flexibility, online/local co-op, and level-editor support on Steam. Console ports are useful access routes, but no sourced platform-exclusive gameplay content over the updated PC version is documented.
primary.how_to_play: Buy Broforce on Steam for Windows PC and play the current build with the free Broforce Forever update installed.

entries.remaster_caveats: Broforce Forever is a free update/final expansion to Broforce, not a separate game entry. The Expendabros is represented separately as a standalone crossover.
